## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and relevant compatibility impact.

## Validation

List commands actually run, results, and any unresolved environment failures.
Use current-source evidence and reproducible steps without private-report links.

- [ ] Repository, type, unit, CI, vendor, and version checks pass.
- [ ] Relevant clean-source, package, browser, and bundler checks pass.
- [ ] Dependency changes include lockfiles, fresh audits, and license notices.
- [ ] Public API changes include an appropriate Changeset.
- [ ] No operator secrets, local evidence, or unexpected generated files are included.
